summary: create four replacement tasks for the approved P06 contracts made stale by A0013
owner_direction: Owner direction: create exactly four new P06 successor task contracts, using the next available task IDs, one successor each for T063, T064, T066 and T067. Each successor must declare replaces for its exact predecessor, depend on that predecessor, preserve all still-valid obligations, repair the A0013 conflict for that predecessor, and contain a complete Replacement and migration section covering old implementation reachability, historical and persisted artifacts, runtime cutover and rollback or fail-closed behavior, downstream dependency rewiring, security implications, and positive, negative, compatibility, migration and old-path-unreachable verification. The manifest successor must bind strategy identity and parameters to the versioned registry while preserving historical manifests read-only and must state the rerun-manifest boundary with the product-level T069 run lifecycle. The robustness successor must constrain parameter surfaces to the registered schema and its declared ranges. The candidate-lock successor must freeze registry identity, schema and revision so a change creates a new candidate version. The authoring-guide successor must teach registered identity as authoritative, treat free-text notes as non-authoritative, and update guide, example and drift tests. Choose dependency ordering that is acyclic and lets planned consumers be repointed away from the predecessors in later CONTRACT amendments. Do not retire predecessors or edit any existing contract in this PROPHET amendment. Update plan structure collateral. Perform the full impact assessment required by the workflow, and record every newly exposed existing-contract conflict with stable exact impact IDs; do not duplicate A0013 impacts as new findings.
